inline_comments.body: This doesn't avoid circular import, it's called upon defining the class

In vllm/tool_parsers/__init__.py, vllm.tool_parsers.abstract_tool_parser is imported. In vllm.tool_parsers.abstract_tool_parser, vllm.entrypoints.serve.engine.protocol is imported. In vllm.entrypoints.serve.engine.protocol, vllm.tool_parsers is imported. 

This circular import is very hard to eliminate, 

so it is difficult for us to put make_tool_call_id in vllm.tool_parsers.
@chaunceyjiang what do you think? Should we keep the existing direction of dependencies or change it in this PR?
